# Event crowd motion artwork

Built-in image tool edits of the existing scene backgrounds remove baked-in guests while preserving the decor. Generated transparent walk cycles, prayer poses, and performer poses are sliced into WebP strips; the existing garba-crowd-poses.png supplies four-frame dance cycles. Source stage, entrance and shrine art remain in the repository.

## stage-clean

Edit the supplied finished painted scene into a clean background plate for an animated website. Remove EVERY human figure, near and distant, and their shadows. Reconstruct the floor/walls/background naturally behind them. Preserve the EXACT camera, framing, architecture, decor, lights, flowers, colors, floor perspective and layout. Do not move or resize any structure. No new props, text, logos or UI. Maintain exact painted anime style and image aspect ratio. Remove the crowd, dancers, singer and band members; preserve circular stage, mandala LED screen, instruments, microphone stands, lotus canopy and lighting. Empty stage and empty ground, no people whatsoever. Landscape1672x941.

## walking-guests

Create a transparent sprite sheet for a believable WALK CYCLE in same hand-painted Gujarati illustrated style as reference. Two adult Navratri guests, not main protagonists. Strict1536x1024 sheet,4 columns x2rows, each384x512cell transparent with full body inside and ample margins. Toprow SAME man in saffron embroidered kediyu, ivory churidar, red small turban across FOUR ordered walk-cycle keyframes, side three-quarter view facing RIGHT. Bottomrow SAME woman in royal blue/gold chaniya choli with burgundy dupatta across FOUR ordered walk-cycle frames facing RIGHT. Frame1 left foot contact forward, frame2 passing, frame3 right foot contact forward, frame4 passing other leg. Modest natural opposite arm swing, grounded feet at same baseline y90% of cell, head same height, no morphing faces/outfits betweenframes, subtlefabricmotion. Adult anatomy, feet/handscorrect, no chibi, no scenery, no text, real transparent alpha, no painted colored backdrop.
